Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

**Purpose:** Reconcile the approved lifecycle contractor engagement against the available invoice and closeout evidence. This worksheet distinguishes authorization, observed charges, and evidence gaps. An approved envelope or purchase-order ceiling is not evidence that the amount was spent.

## Supported — authorization and engagement

| Item | Supported detail | Basis / treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Approved envelope | $24,000 Q1 Growth envelope allocated to the lifecycle QA and operations contractor. | The approval allocated the envelope to this engagement rather than Helio Start paid acquisition. |
| Engagement dates | January 15–February 23, 2024. | Procurement / approval terms; February 23 closeout message also identifies the final week as Feb 17–23. |
| Reporting / supervising owner | Ines. | Approval and PO terms place the work under Ines. |
| Original authorized work | Active Customer.io campaign inventory; experiment-setup hygiene; suppression checks; repeatable preflight work. | Within the January approval. |
| Original PO ceiling | $23,180 not-to-exceed: $20,400 professional services + $1,530 vendor administration fee + up to $1,250 tooling, reimbursable only for actual approved expenses. | Arithmetic: $20,400 + $1,530 + $1,250 = $23,180. This was a ceiling, not a spend amount. It left $820 of the $24,000 envelope uncommitted at PO issuance. |
| Authorized scope add-on | Six hours at $135/hour = $810 for two operator-ready runbooks, bringing the total authorized commitment to $23,990 and leaving $10 of the envelope uncommitted. | Approval was bounded to reproducible audience query and timestamp, suppression and duplicate-admin checks, unsubscribe handling, copy-risk boundaries, release criteria/checks, and rollback steps; Ines independently reruns each preflight. Delivery target: Feb 16. |
| Permitted work categories | Campaign inventory/evidence cataloging; experiment setup hygiene; suppression and duplicate handling checks; repeatable lifecycle preflight; the specifically approved two-campaign runbooks. | Preparation and documentation only; the add-on did not authorize open-ended campaign redesign. |

## Supported — observed invoice subjects / coding

| Subject-line evidence | Amount / status | Reconciliation treatment |
|---|---:|---|
| Invoice LC-101 — Jan 15–Feb 2 lifecycle QA and preflight work | $8,400 — paid | Lifecycle engagement-coded by description and dates. |
| Invoice LC-102 — Feb 3–16 lifecycle operations and suppression checks | $9,100 — paid | Lifecycle engagement-coded by description and dates. |
| **Subtotal of these two visible paid invoice subjects** | **$17,500** | Observed paid charges only; does not include the Feb 17–23 closeout week. |

A separate closeout finance record reports **122.5 approved hours × $145/hour = $17,762.50**, with **$0 expenses**. This amount is arithmetically correct, but the available invoice subjects above total $17,500, a **$262.50 difference**. Treat $17,762.50 as a reported final-invoice figure pending invoice-level tie-out; do not add it to the $17,500 subtotal. The available subject-line evidence does not show whether the final figure supersedes the two invoices, includes an additional amount, or is otherwise reconciled.

## Unresolved — evidence and reconciliation gaps

- Ines’s Feb 23 closeout subject says the **Feb 17–23 invoice and receipt were still outstanding**. Obtain the actual invoice and proof of payment (or confirmation that no charge was issued) before marking that final period settled.
- Tie the reported $17,762.50 final-invoice amount to LC-101, LC-102, and any Feb 17–23 closeout line. Resolve the $262.50 difference; avoid double counting if the final amount is a cumulative total.
- The $1,250 tooling allowance was reimbursable only for actual approved expenses. The separate closeout record reports $0 expenses, but retain the invoice/expense detail to substantiate that no tooling reimbursement was charged.
- The subject lines identify LC-101 and LC-102 as paid, but the accessible subject-line evidence does not provide payment dates, line-item detail, or the final-week receipt. Confirm those from the underlying accounting records.
- The reported 122.5 hours at $145/hour is a final closeout figure; the separately authorized six-hour runbook add-on was priced at $135/hour. Confirm the hours/rate treatment and whether the add-on is included in the reported final total rather than assuming either rate applies to all work.

## Excluded — do not charge to this engagement

| Item / activity | Evidence | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Invoice HS-204 — Helio Start paid-acquisition setup | $2,600, uncoded | Exclude from this contractor engagement and route to the appropriate separate approval/cost center. Paid acquisition was explicitly outside the approved scope and was not funded by this envelope. “Uncoded” is not authorization to assign it here. |
| Any Helio Start paid-media, acquisition setup, or change to Helio Start exposure | Approval and kickoff boundaries | Not an eligible engagement category. |
| Work outside Jan 15–Feb 23, or work beyond the approved inventory, hygiene, suppression, preflight, and bounded runbook scope | Approval and PO terms | Exclude unless separately authorized; the envelope and PO ceiling do not authorize extra work. |
| Unused envelope / unspent commitment | $24,000 envelope; $23,990 maximum authorized commitment after add-on | Not a charge. Do not record the envelope or cap as spent, and do not reallocate residual funds to paid acquisition or invented contractor work. |

## Reconciliation position

The available message subjects support **$17,500 in paid, lifecycle-described invoices** (LC-101 and LC-102), while a separate closeout record reports **$17,762.50** as the final invoice amount. Until the $262.50 difference and Feb 17–23 invoice/receipt evidence are tied out, the final settled spend remains unresolved. The $24,000 envelope and $23,990 authorized commitment are ceilings, not proof of expenditure. The exclusion must be framed as applying to this Q1 2024 envelope, not as a claim that paid acquisition was permanently or universally unfunded.

The worksheet lists LC-101 for $8,400 and LC-102 for $9,100 as supported paid charges within the permitted lifecycle scope and totals those supported charges as exactly $17,500.

The worksheet records that invoice and receipt evidence for February 17–23 remains outstanding or unresolved.
